law.catch_line: A.L. Philpott Manufacturing Extension Partnership established; purpose and duties

text.section: The Extension Partnership is a local or regional industrial or economic development authority or organization for purposes of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act (§ 2.2-3700 et seq.).
